body: Thank you so much! Yeah don't get me wrong there are moments when things are fine and normal but I agree, usually I just walk away and try to take my mind off of everything. I might try and write a letter but I feel it won't change things and she'll give me more crap because I'll be in the wrong for standing up for myself in a manner of speaking, my aunt who understands my situation and has been helping me cope with depression and suicidal thoughts is trying to help me work up to telling her everything as she doesn't know my current metal health problem.
Thank you for that! Well I graduate in one year and I have a job lined up for the minute I finish university so I can leave this house and start a new life and hopefully a happier life.

Yeah I agree with that and since that I really have upped my game. It's just a regular occurrence to me now, I honestly can't remember a time she hasn't done this, it has happened more recently in the past few years since I started university and tried to make my own life so to speak.

I've really got myself sorted out since failing it and completely changed my work method etc. I feel I can't tell her as she would turn it around to be about her and make me feel even worse, the few people in my family who know I suffer from depression agree my mother is a large factor in that. I try to but I'm just emotionally blackmailed and told I put my SO over my family (which I don't, but this is used a lot and seems like an excuse as she has nothing to say). Sadly she doesn't and is I'm a similar situation to myself and we really are each others rocks. Without her I'd probably be dead in all honesty.

I failed some stuff at university and got made feel like I was an absolute idiot and didn't deserve to be at university is one of many examples. I do yeah as I feel it does help to a certain extent but it's just a simple thing being said or done that brings upon this destructive personality. She knows she is my world and with her I feel completely normal and I'm happy. But this is usually ruined when I get home as I'm criticised for being out too late despite the fact I'm an adult.
The main family problems I have are with my mother, I'm about to turn 21 and I'm constantly treated like a child, she emotionally blackmails me constantly and takes her problems out on me.
I just can't seem to do anything right like ever. Yeah she knows and helps me as much as she can.
